en.headline: 390 own commits across 10 repos, 4 skill releases, and 47 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the daily-summary pipeline, a new translation extension, and three OpenCode skills that shipped eight releases between them.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-02 with data for every day. Grand totals are 390 own commits, 0 pull requests, 47 issue actions and 0 reviews; a further 662 automated commits landed in the profile repository. Work concentrated on four things: the daily-summary generator, a new browser translation extension, a family of OpenCode skills, and upstream bug reporting against OpenChamber and OpenCode.

### Daily summary pipeline

In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` the AI summary path was reworked end to end. Reasoning was turned off and the truncation bug fixed at its root, since max_tokens had been counting chain-of-thought and leaving content empty; a deterministic truncation then took heavy-day success from 0% to 100%. Release notes now render Markdown with preserved line breaks, and AI summaries support inline code and bold with a readable code background in dark mode. A test-render assertion collector defect was fixed, mock regression tests added, and the push-collision step hardened.

### Translation and sandbox tooling

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch: an MV3 skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline, then bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting. Selection translation was dropped in favour of page translation, page state is reset between runs, and JSDoc-based checkJs type checking plus a DOM smoke test were added. `opencode-agent-sandbox` stayed documentation-focused, archiving findings on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, auth and Windows path pitfalls, and correcting stale conclusions about subcommands and bundled skills.

### Skill releases

`opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable, and published 0.1.0-rc.0 through 1.2.0, including a 1.1.0 breaking change to a single JSON result envelope with an output schema. `meld-deepresearch` shipped 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and 0.4.0, adding explicit access-blocked handling, validator hints, a three-skill family and a thin `meld.py` CLI. `opencode-go-model-picker` shipped 1.3.0, 1.4.0, 2.0.0 and 3.0.0, adding agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, atomic snapshot writes, priced accounting and a single entry point. `asset-inventory` released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5 correcting skill invocation facts.

### Upstream reports

Most issue activity was upstream. Against `openchamber/openchamber` the reports covered MCP server omission in settings, stale session-retention copy, quote-card and file-view selection bugs, capture resolution, unlinkable issues and context-panel percentages, alongside eleven discussion threads on files-view commenting, extension APIs and encrypted relay keys. Against `anomalyco/opencode` the reports centred on MiMo vision and subagent failures, image input rejected by the Go endpoint, and the missing Windows CLI entry point. Smaller reports went to `oh-my-opencode-slim`, `OfficeCLI` and the two SenseNova skill repositories.

highlights.text: Opened and closed a temporary smoke-test issue for the opencode /oc integration.
Breaking change: all four actions return one JSON object with an output schema instead of Markdown.
Added a thin meld.py CLI wrapping all six gates behind a single --outdir.
Collapsed the skill to one entry point, go.mjs, with run, report, check and apply verbs.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image.
Requested a way to run the CLI that ships with the Windows desktop build.
Opened an OpenCode V2 compatibility report on SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.

zh.headline: 10 个仓库 390 次本人提交，4 个技能发布，47 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 这段时间主要投入在每日摘要流水线、新的翻译扩展，以及三个 OpenCode 技能上，后者合计发布了八个版本。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-04 至 2026-11-02，每天都有数据。总计 390 次本人提交、0 个拉取请求、47 次 issue 互动、0 次评审；另有 662 次自动提交落在个人主页仓库。工作集中在四块：每日摘要生成器、新的浏览器翻译扩展、一组 OpenCode 技能，以及向 OpenChamber 和 OpenCode 上游提交缺陷报告。

### 每日摘要流水线

在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，AI 摘要链路被整体重做。关闭了 reasoning 并从根因修复截断问题（max_tokens 计入了思维链，导致 content 恒为空），随后用确定性截断把重日成功率从 0% 提升到 100%。Release notes 现在会渲染 Markdown 并保留换行，AI 摘要支持行内代码和加粗，代码底色在深色模式下可读。此外修复了 test-render 断言收集器缺陷，补充了 mock 回归测试，并加固了提交步骤的 push 撞车处理。

### 翻译与沙箱工具

`sopen-translate` 从零起步：MV3 骨架、带预设的 provider 协议层、模型列表与术语表流水线，随后实现双语页面渲染、分块切分、熔断与进度上报。选择翻译被移除，只保留页面翻译；两次运行之间会重置页面状态，并加入 JSDoc 的 checkJs 类型检查与 DOM 冒烟测试。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 以文档为主，归档了 OpenCode V2 分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，并修正了子命令、随包技能数量等过期结论。

### 技能发布

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable，并发布了 0.1.0-rc.0 到 1.2.0，其中 1.1.0 是破坏性变更，四个动作统一返回带 output schema 的单个 JSON 对象。`meld-deepresearch` 发布了 0.2.0、0.3.0、0.4.0，加入访问受阻的显式处理、校验器提示、三技能家族和精简的 `meld.py` 命令行。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 1.3.0、1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0，新增 agent 发现与快照摘要脚本、原子写入、计价核算和单一入口。`asset-inventory` 发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5，修正技能调用方式。

### 上游反馈

issue 互动大多在上游。对 `openchamber/openchamber` 报告了设置页遗漏 MCP 服务器、会话保留提示文案过期、引用卡片与文件视图选区问题、截图分辨率、无法解除关联以及上下文面板百分比等缺陷，并发起了十一个讨论帖，涉及文件视图评论、扩展 API 与中继密钥加密。对 `anomalyco/opencode` 的报告集中在 MiMo 视觉与子代理失败、Go 端点拒绝图片输入，以及 Windows 缺少 CLI 入口。另有少量报告提交给 `oh-my-opencode-slim`、`OfficeCLI` 和两个 SenseNova 技能仓库。

highlights.text: 新开并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。
破坏性变更：四个动作改为返回带 output schema 的单个 JSON 对象，不再返回 Markdown。
新增精简的 meld.py 命令行，用单个 --outdir 包裹全部六道关卡。
技能收敛为单一入口 go.mjs，提供 run、report、check、apply 四个动词。
报告设置页的 MCP 列表遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点拒绝所有图片。
请求为 Windows 桌面版随附的 CLI 提供可运行入口。
提交 OpenCode V2 兼容性报告，涉及 SKILL.md frontmatter 与运行时假设。
